500: from ἀντί and Χριστός; an opponent of the Messiah:--antichrist.
501: from (the hold of a ship); to bale up (properly, bilge water), i.e. dip water (with a bucket, pitcher, etc.):--draw (out).
502: from ἀντλέω; a baling-vessel:--thing to draw with.
503: from a compound of ἀντί and ὀφθαλμός; to face:--bear up into.
504: from Α (as a negative particle) and ὕδωρ; waterless, i.e. dry:--dry, without water.
505: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ὑποκρίνομαι; undissembled, i.e. sincere:--without dissimulation (hypocrisy), unfeigned.
506: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ὑποτάσσω; unsubdued, i.e. insubordinate (in fact or temper):--disobedient, that is not put under, unruly.
507: adverb from ἀντί; upward or on the top:--above, brim, high, up.
508: from ἄνω and γῆ; above the ground, i.e. (properly) the second floor of a building; used for a dome or a balcony on the upper story:--upper room.
509: from ἄνω; from above; by analogy, from the first; by implication, anew:--from above, again, from the beginning (very first), the top.
510: from ἀνώτερος; superior, i.e. (locally) more remote:--upper.
511: comparative degree of ἄνω; upper, i.e. (neuter as adverb) to a more conspicuous place, in a former part of the book:--above, higher.
512: from Α (as a negative particle) and the base of ὠφέλιμος; useless or (neuter) inutility:--unprofitable(-ness).
513: probably from (to break; compare ῥήγνυμι); an axe:--axe.
514: probably from ἄγω; deserving, comparable or suitable (as if drawing praise):--due reward, meet, (un-)worthy.
515: from ἄξιος; to deem entitled or fit:--desire, think good, count (think) worthy.
516: adverb from ἄξιος; appropriately:--as becometh, after a godly sort, worthily(-thy).
517: from Α (as a negative particle) and ὁρατός; invisible:--invisible (thing).
518: from ἀπό and the base of ἄγγελος; to announce:--bring word (again), declare, report, shew (again), tell.
519: from ἀπό and (to choke; akin to the base of ἀγκάλη); to strangle oneself off (i.e. to death):--hang himself.
520: from ἀπό and ἄγω; to take off (in various senses):--bring, carry away, lead (away), put to death, take away.
521: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of παιδεύω; uninstructed, i.e. (figuratively) stupid:--unlearned.
522: from ἀπό and αἴρω; to lift off, i.e. remove:--take (away).
523: from ἀπό and αἰτέω; to demand back:--ask again, require.
524: from ἀπό and (to smart); to grieve out, i.e. become apathetic:--be past feeling.
525: from ἀπό and ἀλλάσσω; to change away, i.e. release, (reflexively) remove:--deliver, depart.
526: from ἀπό and a derivative of ἀλλότριος; to estrange away, i.e. (passively and figuratively) to be non-participant:-- alienate, be alien.
528: from ἀπό and a derivative of ἀντί; to meet away, i.e. encounter:--meet.
530: probably from ἅπας; one (or a single) time (numerically or conclusively):--once.
531: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of παραβαίνω; not passing away, i.e. untransferable (perpetual):-- unchangeable.
532: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of παρασκευάζω; unready:--unprepared.
533: from ἀπό and ἀρνέομαι; to deny utterly, i.e. disown, abstain:--deny.
534: from ἀπό and ἄρτι; from now, i.e. henceforth (already):--from henceforth.
535: from a derivative of ἀπάρτι; completion:--finishing.
536: from a compound of ἀπό and ἄρχομαι; a beginning of sacrifice, i.e. the (Jewish) first-fruit (figuratively):--first-fruits.
537: from Α (as a particle of union) and πᾶς; absolutely all or (singular) every one:--all (things), every (one), whole.
538: of uncertain derivation; to cheat, i.e. delude:--deceive.
540: from Α (as a negative particle) and πατήρ; fatherless, i.e. of unrecorded paternity:--without father.
541: from a compound of ἀπό and αὐγάζω; an off-flash, i.e. effulgence:--brightness.
542: from ἀπό and the same as εἴδω; to see fully:--see.
543: from ἀπειθής; disbelief (obstinate and rebellious):--disobedience, unbelief.
544: from ἀπειθής; to disbelieve (wilfully and perversely):--not believe, disobedient, obey not, unbelieving.
545: from Α (as a negative particle) and πείθω; unpersuadable, i.e. contumacious:--disobedient.
546: of uncertain derivation; to menace; by implication, to forbid:--threaten.
547: from ἀπειλέω; a menace:--X straitly, threatening.
548: from ἀπό and εἰμί; to be away:--be absent. Compare ἄπειμι.
549: from ἀπό and (to go); to go away:--go. Compare ἄπειμι.
550: reflexive past of a compound of ἀπό and ἔπω; to say off for oneself, i.e. disown:--renounce.
551: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of πειράω; untried, i.e. not temptable:--not to be tempted.
552: from Α (as a negative particle) and πεῖρα; inexperienced, i.e. ignorant:--unskilful.
553: from ἀπό and ἐκδέχομαι; to expect fully:--look (wait) for.
554: middle voice from ἀπό and ἐκδύω; to divest wholly oneself, or (for oneself) despoil:--put off, spoil.
556: from ἀπό and ἐλαύνω; to dismiss:--drive.
557: from a compound of ἀπό and ἐλέγχω; refutation, i.e. (by implication) contempt:--nought.
558: from ἀπό and ἐλεύθερος; one freed away, i.e. a freedman:--freeman.
559: of Latin origin; Apelles, a Christian:--Apelles.
560: from ἀπό and ἐλπίζω; to hope out, i.e. fully expect:--hope for again.
561: from ἀπό and ἔναντι; from in front, i.e. opposite, before or against:--before, contrary, over against, in the presence of.
562: from Α (as a negative particle) and a secondary derivative of πέραν; unfinished, i.e. (by implication) interminable:--endless.
563: adverb from a compound of Α (as a negative participle) and a presumed derivative of περισπάω; undistractedly, i.e. free from (domestic) solicitude:--without distraction.
564: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of περιτέμνω; uncircumcised (figuratively):--uncircumcised.
565: from ἀπό and ἔρχομαι; to go off (i.e. depart), aside (i.e. apart) or behind (i.e. follow), literally or figuratively:--come, depart, go (aside, away, back, out, … ways), pass away, be past.
566: third person singular present indicative active of ἀπέχω used impersonally; it is sufficient:--it is enough.
567: middle voice (reflexively) of ἀπέχω; to hold oneself off, i.e. refrain:--abstain.
568: from ἀπό and ἔχω; (actively) to have out, i.e. receive in full; (intransitively) to keep (oneself) away, i.e. be distant (literally or figuratively):--be, have, receive.
569: from ἄπιστος; to be unbelieving, i.e. (transitively) disbelieve, or (by implication) disobey:--believe not.
570: from ἄπιστος; faithlessness, i.e. (negatively) disbelief (lack of Christian faith), or (positively) unfaithfulness (disobedience):--unbelief.
571: from Α (as a negative particle) and πιστός; (actively) disbelieving, i.e. without Christian faith (specially, a heathen); (passively) untrustworthy (person), or incredible (thing):--that believeth not, faithless, incredible thing, infidel, unbeliever(-ing).
572: from ἁπλοῦς; singleness, i.e. (subjectively) sincerity (without dissimulation or self-seeking), or (objectively) generosity (copious bestowal):--bountifulness, liberal(-ity), simplicity, singleness.
573: probably from Α (as a particle of union) and the base of πλέκω; properly, folded together, i.e. single (figuratively, clear):--single.
574: adverb from ἁπλοῦς (in the objective sense of ἁπλότης); bountifully; --liberally.
575: a primary particle; "off," i.e. away (from something near), in various senses (of place, time, or relation; literal or figurative):--(X here-)after, ago, at, because of, before, by (the space of), for(-th), from, in, (out) of, off, (up-)on(-ce), since, with. In composition (as a prefix) it usually denotes separation, departure, cessation, completion, reversal, etc.
576: from ἀπό and the base of βάσις; literally, to disembark; figuratively, to eventuate:--become, go out, turn.
577: from ἀπό and βάλλω; to throw off; figuratively, to lose:--cast away.
578: from ἀπό and βλέπω; to look away from everything else, i.e. (figuratively) intently regard:--have respect.
579: from ἀποβάλλω; cast off, i.e. (figuratively) such as to be rejected:--be refused.
580: from ἀποβάλλω; rejection; figuratively, loss:--casting away, loss.
581: past participle of a compound of ἀπό and γίνομαι; absent, i.e. deceased (figuratively, renounced):--being dead.
582: from ἀπογράφω; an enrollment; by implication, an assessment:--taxing.
583: from ἀπό and γράφω; to write off (a copy or list), i.e. enrol:--tax, write.
584: from ἀπό and δεικνύω; to show off, i.e. exhibit; figuratively, to demonstrate, i.e. accredit:--(ap-)prove, set forth, shew.
586: from ἀπό and δεκατόω; to tithe (as debtor or creditor):--(give, pay, take) tithe.
588: from ἀπό and δέχομαι; to take fully, i.e. welcome (persons), approve (things):--accept, receive (gladly).
589: from ἀπόδημος; to go abroad, i.e. visit a foreign land:--go (travel) into a far country, journey.
590: from ἀπό and δῆμος; absent from one's own people, i.e. a foreign traveller:--taking a far journey.
591: from ἀπό and δίδωμι; to give away, i.e. up, over, back, etc. (in various applications):--deliver (again), give (again), (re-)pay(-ment be made), perform, recompense, render, requite, restore, reward, sell, yield.
592: from ἀπό and a compound of διά and ὁρίζω; to disjoin (by a boundary, figuratively, a party):--separate.
593: from ἀπό and δοκιμάζω; to disapprove, i.e. (by implication) to repudiate:--disallow, reject.
595: from ἀποτίθημι; a laying aside (literally or figuratively):--putting away (off).
596: from ἀποτίθημι; a repository, i.e. granary:--barn, garner.
597: from ἀπό and θησαυρίζω; to treasure away:--lay up in store.
598: from ἀπό and θλίβω; to crowd (from every side):--press.
599: from ἀπό and θνήσκω; to die off (literally or figuratively):--be dead, death, die, lie a-dying, be slain (X with).
